subject.title: Surface internal system messages in a distinct UI block instead of normal chat bubbles

question: Should visible runtime/system-originated messages be hidden by default, rendered as dedicated diagnostic/system blocks, or continue through ordinary chat grouping for some system rows?
rationale: The source supports several implementation shapes, but the choice affects transcript projection, Control UI/WebChat rendering, TUI parity, and restart-continuation behavior, so automation should not choose the product policy by itself.

options.title: Define Shared Audience Contract
options.body: Choose a core hidden-vs-diagnostic audience model first, then implement Gateway projection and UI/TUI rendering from that contract.

options.title: Hide Runtime Internals
options.body: Treat system/runtime-originated prompts as agent-only unless a source explicitly opts into user-visible diagnostics.

options.title: Style Current System Rows Only
options.body: Add a distinct system block for role `system` rows without changing visibility semantics, accepting that some agent-only text may still be exposed.

recommendation.title: Define Shared Audience Contract
recommendation.body: Choose a core hidden-vs-diagnostic audience model first, then implement Gateway projection and UI/TUI rendering from that contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest product-boundary history is in Gateway display projection and system-event handling, which are central to the policy decision.
